2026-09-24 19:54:59.726119 | controller |
2026-09-24 19:54:59.726624 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-24 19:54:59.726642 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-24 19:54:59.726647 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-24 19:54:59.726651 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-24 19:54:59.726661 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-24 19:54:59.726672 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-24 19:54:59.726676 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
